slug: 2025-12-15 Strengthening Civil Registration and Ending Statelessness in South Sudan

SSD.note: Names birth registration and national ID pilots but no exchange of records between them.

facts.fact: Anecdotal estimates say only about 10% of South Sudan's roughly 12 million people hold Nationality Certificates (about 1.2 million, share as stated), and the country has yet to issue National ID cards at scale, per Hold the Child.

systems.owner: Department of Civil Registry, Nationality, Passport and Immigration
Department of Civil Registry, Nationality, Passport and Immigration

SSD.note: A birth-registration pilot at Juba Teaching Hospital is described with no ID number given at birth.
Says nothing of who operates or maintains an ID system.
Says nothing of public registers keyed on an ID number.

facts.fact: Hold the Child says that over five years its work with the Directorate of Civil Registry and UNHCR has piloted National ID processing, while National ID cards are not yet issued at scale.
